claims.location: comment[label] + characteristics[genetic modification] + characteristics[treatment] + factor value[genetic modification] rows 1-240
claims.value: SILAC light = untransfected MCF-7 internal-standard pool (untransfected / untreated); SILAC medium = empty pCMV4 vector transfection (Transfection); SILAC heavy = pCMV4-FLAG-deltaN-IkappaBalpha (NFKBIA deltaN36 super-repressor) transfection (Transfection)
claims.evidence: Paper Methods (line 116): light L-Lys/L-Arg; medium D4-L-lysine + 13C6-L-arginine; heavy 13C6-15N2-L-lysine + 13C6-15N4-L-arginine. Line 122: 'pCMV4-FLAG-dN IkBa plasmid to the H population ..., empty pCMV4 plasmid to the M population ..., and empty medium to the L population'. Results (line 188): 'cells labeled with heavy amino acids were transfected with plasmid encoding IkBa (NFKBIA) ... Control MCF-7 cells transfected with empty plasmid were labeled with medium isotopes'; 'heavy/light and medium/light SILAC ratios for cell samples with inhibited and uninhibited NF-kB, respectively'. MaxQuant label states agree with the isotopes: M = Arg6;Lys4, H = Arg10;Lys8. Data check limited: NFKBIA (P25963) is not in proteinGroups.txt, so the bait cannot confirm the H/M direction (see limitations); global log2 median normalized H/M -0.17, H/L +0.61, M/L +0.74 (orientation.txt) are uninformative for direction. Three statements in the paper agree, no conflicting source.

Paper line 126/130: equal volumes of H and M lysates were mixed and SEC-separated into 80 fractions; each run is one SEC fraction of that mixture, so the H and M material of each run is a distinct physical sample (SEC fraction nn of the respective lysate) -> one source per (channel, SEC fraction). The light channel is an aliquot of ONE physical pool: the L lysate was separated into 20 SEC fractions which were pooled and the pool evenly distributed to all 80 H/M fractions as internal standard. Its 80 source names (one per run, validation.md:22-23, required by build) are aliquots of that single pool, not 80 independent samples.

claims.evidence: Batch rule 16 / precedents PXD004650, PXD014436: the SEC fraction is the measured sample in PCP (the readout is the per-fraction H/L and M/L elution profile, paper line 188), so it is a sample property and factor, not comment[fraction identifier] (quantms would otherwise merge the 80 fractions into one sample). Fraction numbers from Experimental_design.xlsx Tab. 1A, identical to MaxQuant summary.txt Fraction. The L internal standard is a pool of all L SEC fractions, so it has no single SEC fraction. Custom characteristics column per spec 'Extending Templates'. comment[fractionation method] omitted for the same reason as PXD014436 (fractionation is encoded as a sample property).

claims.value: H/M = study sample, not pooled; L = reference, pooled
claims.evidence: L is the spiked internal standard (paper line 130, 188): reference PRIDE:0000899 (descendant of PRIDE:0000895 via multiplex sample, precedent PXD003316/PXD038030); pooled because it is the pool of 20 SEC fractions of the L lysate. H and M are the study samples (PRIDE:0001013).

Paper line 112: 'one biological replicate labeled with SILAC'; each channel population is one culture (4 x 15 cm plates pooled per SILAC population, line 116/126). Within each factor-value group (genetic modification x SEC fraction) there is exactly one culture, and the L reference group is one culture, so 1 is the correct per-group number (rule 3), not a default.

limitations: PARTIAL SCOPE: only the SEC-PCP-SILAC arm (80 Orbitrap Fusion Lumos runs 3502_Bouchal_Lumik2_*.raw) is annotated. Excluded as non-SILAC (also listed in BLOCKED.md 'excluded runs'): 80 SEC-label-free Impact II QTOF runs (4641_QTOF1-batch1/-batch3/-batch4_*.d.zip, 40 inhibited + 40 uninhibited, Experimental_design.xlsx sheet SEC_PCP_SILAC_80_label_free_fr), 34 SEC label-free runs of untransfected cells (2494_QTOF1_*.d.zip, sheet SEC_label_free_34_fr), 24 RELA/IgG immunoprecipitation DIA runs (4626_Lumos1_*_{DN,EM}_{CTRL,RELA}*.raw) and 8 total-proteome DIA runs (4642_Lumos1_134_PB_DIA_win_{DN,EM}*.raw); these are label-free/DIA and would need their own SDRFs (rule 12).

Not data runs: Experimental_design.xlsx, MaxQuant_1.6.2.10.zip and MaxQuant_2.0.3.0.zip (software), MassTolerances_*.txt, *.sne Spectronaut files, *_Andromeda_Peak_Lists.zip, *_MaxQuant_Search_Results.zip, *_FullMaxQuantFolder.zip.

Channel-map data check is weaker than wanted: the bait NFKBIA (P25963, FLAG-dN-IkBa) is not identified in the SILAC proteinGroups.txt, so the H = dN-IkBa / M = empty vector assignment rests on three concordant explicit statements in the paper Methods/Results plus the MaxQuant label-state/isotope correspondence, not on a ratio check. Supplemental File 2 (SILAC ratios) is not in the PMC OA package and was not consulted.
The 80 light-channel source names are aliquots of one physical pool (L internal standard), not independent samples.
iRT peptides (Biognosys) were spiked into all samples (paper line 136); not encoded as characteristics[spiked compound] because no quantity is stated.
Culture medium SILAC Advanced DMEM/F12 Flex has no NCIT term -> not available.
No external review run here (REVIEW_PENDING_EXTERNAL); not self-approved.
